overview: Isolated late Puercan astragali and calcanea attributed to Purgatorius preserve mobile-ankle features used to test arboreality and a primate-side placement.

ecology.diet: Diet not tested by the isolated tarsals
ecology.habitat: Arboreal use inferred from ankle mobility; depositional setting alone is not habitat
ecology.locomotion: Mobile ankle and inverted-foot capability inferred from tarsal form
ecology.bodySize: Small-bodied mammal; mass estimated comparatively, not measured
ecology.guild: Arboreal locomotor interpretation with diet unresolved

evidenceSummary: UCMP 197509 and UCMP 197517 are isolated bones attributed by comparative regressions and matrices; they are not associated with teeth and do not establish crown-Primate membership or direct ancestry.

overview: Part and counterpart of one juvenile skeleton preserve unusually complete anatomy, soft-tissue outline and gut contents, while preparation history and phylogenetic placement require explicit qualification.

ecology.diet: Plant material inferred from preserved gut contents
ecology.habitat: Messel lake ecosystem; habitual microhabitat remains inferred
ecology.locomotion: Arboreal quadrupedal interpretation from hands, feet and limbs
ecology.bodySize: Juvenile individual; adult body size cannot be read directly
ecology.guild: Small arboreal plant-eater inferred from one juvenile

evidenceSummary: PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are opposite slabs of one skeleton. Fabricated portions of plate B were disclosed, and no feature makes the specimen a demonstrated anthropoid ancestor.

commonNameZh: 狭鼻猴干群萨达猴标本
overview: Holotype SGS-UM 2009-002 is a partial cranium combining crown-catarrhine features with no diagnostic ape or Old World monkey specialization in the published matrix.

ecology.diet: Diet inferred from preserved dentition; direct feeding evidence absent
ecology.habitat: Shumaysi depositional setting; habitual habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the partial cranium
ecology.bodySize: Known from a partial adult cranium; body mass is model dependent
ecology.guild: Dietary guild unresolved beyond dental inference

evidenceSummary: The holotype and a 36-character matrix support a stem-catarrhine test, but the 29–28 Ma age is biochronological and does not directly date the crown split or identify an ancestor.

overview: Separately catalogued Teilhardina dental samples from three correlated PETM sections document a short Asia-to-Europe-to-North-America appearance sequence, not one tracked population or an ancestor chain.

ecology.diet: Dental samples do not directly record diet
ecology.habitat: Section and carbon-isotope context, not habitual habitat
ecology.locomotion: Not preserved by the dental samples
ecology.bodySize: Body mass is not directly estimated from the reported sequence
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved from these samples

traits: Dental comparisons across three PETM sections
evidenceSummary: Smith, Rose and Gingerich document the samples, section correlations and dental comparisons on pp. 11223–11227 (Figures 1–3 and Supporting Tables). Species assignments and correlation underpin the sequence, so it is not a direct record of migration, crown membership or a global first appearance.

commonNameZh: 莫罗古猿姿势骨骼样本
overview: Separate shoulder and femoral specimens MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 from Moroto I and II provide a comparative test of early-Miocene hominoid locomotion; they are not an associated skeleton or demonstrated crown-ape ancestor.

ecology.diet: No direct dietary evidence from the two postcranial specimens
ecology.habitat: Moroto locality context; habitual habitat is not directly established
ecology.locomotion: Mixed arboreal repertoire inferred by comparative functional analysis
ecology.bodySize: Postcranial size estimates are comparative and specimen bounded
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved beyond locomotor interpretation

traits: Shoulder morphology in the Moroto sample
Femoral morphology in the Moroto sample
evidenceSummary: MacLatchy and colleagues describe and compare MUZM 60 and MUZM 80 across pp. 159–183 (Figures 1–12; Tables 1–10). Their locality attribution, functional reconstruction and hominoid implications are distinct inference steps and do not establish observed behaviour or a direct ancestor.

commonNameZh: 布里杰组北猴足部样本
overview: A semi-articulated Notharctus foot represented by AMNH 143612 and AMNH 143640 preserves ray-specific phalanges used to test the identity and function of a digit-two grooming claw; the specimen comparison is not a crown-primate or direct-ancestor claim.

ecology.diet: Diet is not directly recorded by the cited foot material
ecology.habitat: Bridger Formation provenance does not establish habitual microhabitat
ecology.locomotion: Foot proportions permit functional comparison, but locomotor behaviour was not observed
ecology.bodySize: The cited study does not establish a population-wide body-size estimate
ecology.guild: Ecological guild remains unresolved from the foot anatomy

evidenceSummary: Maiolino and colleagues document the specimen association and phalangeal comparisons in e29135, Figures 3–10 and Table 2. The grooming-claw interpretation is a functional inference bounded to the named foot, not observed grooming behaviour or a universal primate condition.

commonNameZh: 中始新世曙猿孤立跗骨样本
overview: Isolated calcanei and tali from Shanghuang and Yuanqu were attributed to Eosimias and compared in a character matrix testing anthropoid affinity; they are not dentally associated skeletons, a direct ancestor, or a complete record of Eosimias anatomy.

ecology.diet: Diet is not directly recorded by the isolated tarsals
ecology.habitat: Fissure-fill and basin provenance do not establish habitual habitat
ecology.locomotion: Tarsal form supports comparative locomotor interpretation, not observed behaviour
ecology.bodySize: Body-size reconstruction from isolated tarsals remains comparative
ecology.guild: Ecological guild is unresolved from the sampled ankle bones

traits: Mosaic of tarsal characters used in an anthropoid-affinity test
evidenceSummary: Gebo and colleagues report the isolated tarsals and their sampled character comparisons on pp. 276–278, Figure 1 and Supplementary Tables 1–2. Attribution and stem-anthropoid placement are matrix-dependent inferences; the bones are not directly associated with the dental hypodigm.

overview: COL26.8 usage 4C92G is the accepted species record for Pan troglodytes; the selected biological evidence is bounded to one wild community at Bossou.

ecology.diet: The selected study records feeding locations but does not provide a species-wide diet synthesis.
ecology.habitat: At Bossou, mature forest was the most selected habitat overall in the sampled wild community; this is a site-level result.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected habitat-use study.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected habitat-use study.
ecology.guild: Not established by the selected one-site habitat-use study.

evidenceSummary: A year of daily follows at Bossou sampled one local community, including 10 adult focal individuals. These observations do not establish species-wide habitat use or a current range-wide synthesis.

context.en: Continue with another featured primate introduction.
context.zh: 继续阅读另一篇精选灵长类物种介绍。

title.en: A range account with a date attached
title.zh: 有年代边界的分布记录

text.en: The 2016 IUCN assessment described a discontinuous range of more than 2.6 million km², from southern Senegal across the forest belt north of the Congo River to western Tanzania and western Uganda. It described four subspecies ranges. This is a dated assessment account, not a current range map.
text.zh: IUCN 2016 年评估记载，黑猩猩分布区不连续，面积超过 260 万平方公里，从塞内加尔南部沿刚果河以北的森林带延伸至坦桑尼亚西部和乌干达西部，并分别描述四个亚种的分布。这是一份有明确年代的评估记录，不是当前分布图。

title.en: What one forest-edge study found
title.zh: 一项森林边缘研究的发现

text.en: At Bossou, Guinea, researchers followed one wild western chimpanzee community for up to six hours a day from April 2012 to March 2013, including 10 adult focal individuals. Mature forest was the most selected habitat overall. Among feeding events in uncultivated habitat, records more than 200 m from fields exceeded chance expectations, while the 0–200 m bands fell below them. The authors suggested field-associated risks may shape feeding locations; this is a local result, not a species-wide habitat rule.
text.zh: 在几内亚 Bossou，研究者于 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月跟踪一个野生西部黑猩猩群体，每天至多观察 6 小时，焦点样本包括 10 只成年个体。总体上，成熟林是选择比例最高的栖地。在非耕地栖地记录的取食事件中，距耕地超过 200 米的次数高于随机预期，0–200 米范围内则低于预期。作者提出耕地相关风险可能影响取食地点；这是当地群体的结果，不是全物种的栖地规律。

title.en: A task-specific view of learning stick use
title.zh: 从特定任务观察棍棒使用

text.en: At Taï National Park in Côte d’Ivoire, a cross-sectional video study recorded 1,460 stick-use events from 70 wild western chimpanzees in three neighboring communities. In a model of grips used to insert sticks, the multi-digit grip became predominant at about 5.2 years, with a 98% predicted probability of use by age 15. Only three females from one community contributed observations above 45 years. The pattern describes this extractive-foraging task and sample; it is not a universal developmental curve or proof of a cognitive cause.
text.zh: 在科特迪瓦 Taï 国家公园，横断面视频研究记录了三个相邻野生西部黑猩猩群体中 70 只个体的 1,460 次棍棒使用事件。针对棍棒插入动作的握法模型估计，多指握法约在 5.2 岁成为主导，到 15 岁时预测使用概率为 98%。45 岁以上的观察仅来自一个群体的 3 只雌性。这一模式只描述所研究的取食任务与样本，不能当作普遍发育曲线，也不能证明认知成因。

title.en: Growing up and first births at Gombe
title.zh: 贡贝种群的成熟与首次生育

text.en: Long-term records at Gombe National Park in western Tanzania covered 36 known-age wild females. Their mean age at sexual maturity was 11.5 years; mean age at first birth was 14.9 years. First-birth estimates came from a smaller, censored subset in which non-dispersing females were overrepresented, so they may be biased low. These are estimates for one population, not fixed values for every chimpanzee.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝国家公园的长期记录纳入 36 只已知年龄的野生雌性黑猩猩。其性成熟平均年龄为 11.5 岁，首次生育平均年龄为 14.9 岁。首次生育估计来自更小且包含删失记录的子样本，其中未迁出的雌性比例偏高，因此估计值可能偏低。这些是一个种群的估计，不是每只黑猩猩都遵循的固定数值。

title.en: Why captive body-mass comparisons need context
title.zh: 圈养体重比较需要什么背景

text.en: A study compared 298 chimpanzees in African sanctuaries, 1,030 in zoos and 442 in research facilities. After age adjustment, adult animals in zoos and research facilities had greater body mass than sanctuary animals in both sexes; estimated growth was slower in the sanctuary cohort. The groups included mixed or unknown subspecies and different care settings, so this comparison cannot stand in for wild morphology or a subspecies comparison.
text.zh: 一项研究比较了非洲救护中心的 298 只黑猩猩、动物园的 1,030 只和研究机构的 442 只。校正年龄后，动物园与研究机构的成年个体在雌雄中体重都高于救护中心个体；救护中心队列的估计生长速度较慢。各组包含不同或未知亚种，照护环境也不同，因此不能把该比较当作野生形态或亚种间差异。

title.en: A model of deep population history
title.zh: 关于深层种群史的模型

text.en: A whole-genome site-pattern study sampled four chimpanzee lineages—central, eastern, Nigeria–Cameroon and western—alongside bonobos. Its best-fitting model estimated gene flow from western into eastern chimpanzees and placed the shared ancestor of the four sampled chimpanzee lineages at about 987,000 years ago. These are model-based population-history estimates with competing histories discussed by the authors, not dates from fossils.
text.zh: 一项全基因组位点模式研究在倭黑猩猩之外，还采样了中部、东部、尼日利亚—喀麦隆和西部四个黑猩猩谱系。拟合最佳的模型估计西部向东部黑猩猩发生过基因流动，并将四个受采样黑猩猩谱系的共同祖先时间估为约 987,000 年前。这些是种群史模型估计，作者也讨论了其他可能历史；它们不是化石定年结果。

title.en: A regional conservation estimate, not a current census
title.zh: 区域保育模型不是当前普查

text.en: A spatial model estimated 128,760 weaned central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa in 2013 (95% CI 114,208–317,039); it estimated that 80.7% of this subspecies in the modeled region was outside the protected-area network. The result concerns one subspecies and a historical model period. The IUCN assessment linked above is version 2016-2, with errata published in 2018; its Endangered category is not presented as a verified current status.
text.zh: 一项空间模型估算，2013 年西赤道非洲的中部黑猩猩亚种有 128,760 只已断奶个体（95% 置信区间：114,208–317,039）；模型还估计该区域内 80.7% 的这一亚种个体位于保护区网络之外。结果只针对一个亚种和历史模型时期。上文所引 IUCN 评估为 2016-2 版，2018 年发布勘误；其中的“濒危”类别并未被当作经核实的当前状态。

title.en: Humle et al. (2016). Pan troglodytes. The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species, version 2016-2.
title.zh: Humle 等（2016）：Pan troglodytes，《IUCN 受威胁物种红色名录》2016-2 版。

scope.en: Dated species-level assessment with a 2016 range account and status; errata were published in 2018. It is not verified here as the current Red List assessment.
scope.zh: 有年代的物种级评估，分布记述与状态来自 2016 版，2018 年发布勘误；此处未将其核实为当前红色名录评估。

title.en: Bryson-Morrison et al. (2017). Activity and habitat use at Bossou, Guinea.
title.zh: Bryson-Morrison 等（2017）：几内亚 Bossou 的活动与栖地利用研究。

scope.en: One wild P. t. verus community at Bossou, followed from April 2012 to March 2013; 10 adult focal individuals.
scope.zh: 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月在 Bossou 跟踪一个野生 P. t. verus 群体，焦点样本为 10 只成年个体。

title.en: Malherbe et al. (2024). Protracted development of stick tool use skills in wild western chimpanzees.
title.zh: Malherbe 等（2024）：野生西部黑猩猩棍棒工具使用技能的延长发育。

scope.en: Cross-sectional video study of three neighboring Taï communities, November 2013–April 2020; stick-based extractive-foraging tasks.
scope.zh: 2013 年 11 月至 2020 年 4 月对 Taï 三个相邻群体开展的横断面视频研究，观察棍棒取食任务。

title.en: Walker et al. (2018). Maturation is prolonged and variable in female chimpanzees.
title.zh: Walker 等（2018）：雌性黑猩猩的成熟期延长且存在差异。

scope.en: Long-term life-history records for known-age wild females at Gombe, western Tanzania; 36 females in the maturation analysis.
scope.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝的野生雌性长期生活史记录；成熟分析纳入 36 只已知年龄个体。

title.en: Curry et al. (2023). Body mass and growth rates in captive chimpanzees across care settings.
title.zh: Curry 等（2023）：不同照护环境下圈养黑猩猩的体重与生长速度。

scope.en: Comparison of sanctuary, zoo and research cohorts with mixed or unavailable subspecies; not a wild body-size estimate.
scope.zh: 比较救护中心、动物园与研究机构队列；亚种混合或未知，不是野生体型估计。

title.en: Brand et al. (2022). Estimating bonobo and chimpanzee evolutionary history from nucleotide site patterns.
title.zh: Brand 等（2022）：从核苷酸位点模式估计倭黑猩猩与黑猩猩的演化史。

scope.en: Whole-genome site-pattern analysis across the five extant Pan lineages; history and dates are model estimates.
scope.zh: 覆盖现生 Pan 五个谱系的全基因组位点模式分析；历史与年代均为模型估计。

title.en: Strindberg et al. (2018). Guns, germs, and trees determine density and distribution of gorillas and chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa.
title.zh: Strindberg 等（2018）：武器、病原与森林影响西赤道非洲大猩猩和黑猩猩的密度与分布。

scope.en: Historical 2013 model estimate for central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa, not the whole species.
scope.zh: 对西赤道非洲中部黑猩猩亚种的 2013 年历史模型估计，不代表整个物种。

readerLimitations.en: This reader draft brings together selected studies, not a complete species review. The available sources do not provide a current range or conservation assessment, or a broad wild diet, locomotion and morphology synthesis. The scientific dossier remains incomplete and has not received external expert review.
readerLimitations.zh: 这篇读者初稿串联的是若干研究，不是完整物种综述。现有来源没有提供当前分布或保育评估，也不足以综合野外饮食、运动方式与形态。科学档案仍未完成，且尚未经过外部专家评审。

geography: Buxa Tiger Reserve, West Bengal, India (one troop study site)
Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico (managed free-ranging morphology study population)
overview: COL26.8 usage 3WWNQ is the accepted species record for Macaca mulatta. The selected ecological and morphology findings describe one Indian troop and one Cayo Santiago cohort; neither is a species-wide synthesis.

ecology.diet: At Buxa, fruit accounted for 70.8% of recorded diet in the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% in the October–April provisioning period for one 64-individual troop.
ecology.habitat: The selected Buxa troop home range included patches of natural forest, mixed-species plantations and residential settlements; this is one local study setting, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.bodySize: The Buxa ecology study did not estimate species-wide body size; see the separate Cayo Santiago morphology claim for its measured cohort.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected studies.

traits: In one 2015 Cayo Santiago pedigree sample, most measured male morphometric traits were heritable under the study’s pooled models; this cohort result is not species-wide.
evidenceSummary: One-year monitoring of an 11-km NH-7 segment near Pench recorded 54 rhesus macaque road deaths in 2009–2010 (27 summer, 19 winter, 8 monsoon). Local associations with traffic and roadside feeding do not establish population mortality or current/global conservation status.

geography: Lake Manyara National Park, Tanzania (wild road-transect study, 2011–2019)
Gombe National Park, Tanzania (wild reproductive records, 1972–2002)
CNRS Primatology Station, Rousset-sur-Arc, France (captive longitudinal cohort)
overview: COL26.8 accepted usage 6TM9B identifies Papio anubis. Selected primary studies describe captive growth, wild Gombe reproductive records, and a Lake Manyara population-monitoring method. These distinct samples do not form a species-wide synthesis.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected core studies.
ecology.habitat: The Lake Manyara paper compares road-transect estimates with a sleeping-site-based upper limit; roads are a possible source of sampling bias, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core studies.
ecology.bodySize: A seven-year captive cohort study measured segmental morphometrics from infancy to adulthood; its growth pattern is not a species-wide body-size estimate.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core studies.

traits: In one seven-year captive cohort, measured size and shape were similar at birth; later differences in growth rate and duration produced substantial size differences while measured body shape remained similar.
evidenceSummary: The selected profile links primary evidence for morphology, reproduction, and a site-specific population-monitoring bias. Global distribution, fossil record, formal conservation status, and species-wide evolutionary synthesis remain unassessed; this dossier is incomplete and has not received independent expert review.

geography: Mysore-connected roadside transects, Karnataka, India (comparative counts, 2003 and 2015; study site)
Parambikulam landscape, Kerala, India (one forest occupancy survey)
Southern Indian temple/tourist locations (historical site-status comparison)
overview: COL26.8 accepted usage 3WWP2 identifies Macaca radiata. The selected 2017 primary study samples roadside counts around Mysore, forest occupancy at Parambikulam and temple/tourist-site histories in southern India; these bounded sites do not define a current range or species-wide population trend.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.habitat: At Parambikulam, 54 groups were detected in 33 of 64 grid cells and modelled mean occupancy was 0.51 ± 0.08 (SE); this is one forest survey, not a complete habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.guild: Not assessed as a broader species-level ecological guild.

evidenceSummary: Selected evidence comes from one 2017 study: a single-forest occupancy survey, a historical temple/tourist-site comparison and roadside counts on roads connected to Mysore. Morphology, life history, evolution, species-range limits, fossil record and current formal conservation status remain unassessed; this profile is incomplete and has not received independent expert review.

geography: Western Ghats, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, India (15 named sampling sites, 2010–2012; wild fecal samples)
Puthuthottam forest fragment, Valparai plateau, Tamil Nadu, India (one troop; February–May 2016 study site)
overview: COL26.8 accepted species usage 3WWP6 identifies Macaca silenus (Linnaeus, 1758).

ecology.diet: At Puthuthottam, the studied troop consumed plant parts from 19 plant species and other non-plant foods; plant feeding was greater in the forest interior than at the forest edge, while invertebrate feeding was greater in the open patch than in the interior. This is a single-troop dry-season result.
ecology.habitat: During over 480 follow-hours in one habituated troop, active foraging was higher in the open forest patch and forest edge, and lower in the human settlement than in the forest interior; the activity budget differed between interior and settlement. One troop was observed from February to May 2016.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.guild: Not assessed as a broader species-level ecological guild.

evidenceSummary: The ecological profile is based on one habituated troop observed during the 2016 dry season. These local observations are incomplete species evidence, not a range-wide or annual ecological synthesis.

geography: Brazil: northeastern coastal and inland records described by the selected study as native; southern records in São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais described as introductions. Presence-only study compilation, not exhaustive range limits.
overview: COL26.8 accepted usage 697NS identifies Callithrix jacchus (Linnaeus, 1758). Selected evidence covers one captive-colony offspring study, Brazilian passive rabies surveillance and sampled mitochondrial lineages; this is not a complete species review.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.habitat: The selected studies do not establish a species-wide habitat profile. Observed localities and modeled habitat suitability in the rabies study are distinct evidence.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.

evidenceSummary: The core profile links a captive-colony association between paternal responsiveness and infant outcomes, Brazilian passive rabies reports, and a model-based mitochondrial-lineage estimate. These sources do not establish wild life history, species-wide ecology, complete distribution, a nuclear-genome divergence date or formal conservation status.

context.en: Continue with another featured primate introduction.
context.zh: 继续阅读另一篇精选灵长类物种介绍。

title.en: A coat pattern described from adult samples
title.zh: 来自成体样本的毛色描述

text.en: A Brazilian study sampled 30 adult C. jacchus among 209 adult Callithrix specimens collected from mixed wild and captive sources during 2015–2019. It described grey-tipped crown hairs, a grey chin, white ear tufts and a prominent forehead star, with dark or grey dorsal bands over orange underfur. In the sampled adult comparison, mean values for 13 measured traits did not differ significantly from C. penicillata. These are comparative sample descriptions, not a stand-alone field diagnosis; hybrids may show overlapping pelage.
text.zh: 一项巴西研究在 2015–2019 年采集的 209 只成年柽柳猴中纳入 30 只普通狨，样本来源混有野生与圈养个体。论文描述其额顶部前半部毛尖多为灰色、颏部灰色、耳周有蓬松白色耳簇、额头有明显白色星斑，背部黑色或灰白色上毛覆盖橙色底毛。在该成体比较样本中，13 项测量的均值与黑耳狨（C. penicillata）没有显著差异。这些是样本中的比较性描述，不是单独的野外确诊标准；杂交个体的毛色可能重叠。

title.en: Native and introduced records in Brazil
title.zh: 巴西的原生与引入记录

text.en: The study’s occurrence-only compilation treated coastal and inland records in northeastern Brazil as native, and records in São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais as introductions. Observed locations, modeled habitat suitability and a complete range are different kinds of evidence. The compiled records do not set exhaustive range limits or prove absence elsewhere.
text.zh: 该研究仅含出现记录的资料汇编，将巴西东北部沿海与内陆记录列为原生区域，将圣保罗、巴拉那、里约热内卢和米纳斯吉拉斯的记录列为引入区域。实际出现地点、模型预测的栖地适宜性和完整分布范围是不同类型的证据；这份汇编不能确定完整边界，也不能证明其他地区没有分布。

title.en: A captive study of fathers and infant outcomes
title.zh: 圈养研究中的父亲照料与幼体结果

text.en: At one Wisconsin research colony, 24 experienced fathers and 62 offspring were included in a study of responses to infant distress calls. Offspring of fathers classified as responsive had higher survival beyond one month (p = 0.002); the paper also reported group weight differences at weeks 28 and 30. This is an association from one captive-colony study, not a wild survival estimate or proof that the response caused the outcome.
text.zh: 威斯康星一处研究圈养群体中，研究纳入 24 位有育幼经验的父亲及 62 只幼体，比较父亲对幼体求救叫声的反应。被归为会回应的父亲，其幼体超过一个月后的存活率较高（p = 0.002）；论文还报告第 28 和 30 周两组体重有差异。这是单一圈养群体中的关联，不是野外存活率估计，也不能证明父亲的反应造成了该结果。

title.en: What Brazilian rabies surveillance can show
title.zh: 巴西狂犬病监测能说明什么

text.en: Brazilian Ministry of Health passive surveillance recorded 67 rabies outbreaks affecting common marmosets, with 91 cases across 41 municipalities from January 2008 through October 2020. The study reported spillover of a Desmodus rotundus antigenic variant to C. jacchus in northern and southern reporting areas. These records describe reported outbreaks and an identified pathogen interaction; they do not measure disease prevalence throughout the species’ range.
text.zh: 巴西卫生部被动监测资料记录，2008 年 1 月至 2020 年 10 月，41 个市镇报告了影响普通狨的 67 起狂犬病疫情，共 91 例。研究还报告在北部和南部报告区域出现了吸血蝠（Desmodus rotundus）抗原变异株向普通狨的溢出。这些记录说明的是报告疫情和已识别的病原相互作用，不是该物种全分布区的患病率测量。

title.en: A conservation question involving introduced relatives
title.zh: 引入近缘种带来的保育问题

text.en: In a sample of 18 free-living marmosets with putative hybrid appearance from four southeastern Brazilian localities, five carried a C. jacchus maternal COX2 haplotype. The study discusses hybridization between native threatened C. aurita and introduced congeners, including the common marmoset, as a conservation concern. The sample does not estimate hybridization frequency in C. jacchus, measure population effects or establish the common marmoset’s conservation status.
text.zh: 一项研究在巴西东南部四个地点采集的 18 只自由活动、外形疑似杂交的绒猴中，检出 5 只带有普通狨母系 COX2 单倍型。论文将原生受威胁种 C. aurita 与包括普通狨在内的引入近缘种之间的杂交列为保育关注。该样本没有估计普通狨种群中的杂交频率或种群影响，也不能确定普通狨自身的保育状态。

title.en: A mitochondrial lineage estimate, not a species origin date
title.zh: 线粒体谱系估计不是物种起源日期

text.en: A study combining 49 newly sequenced Callithrix mitogenomes with published sequences estimated that sampled C. jacchus and the Caatinga lineage of C. penicillata were sister lineages that diverged about 0.51 million years ago. The estimate depends on the sampled mitochondrial lineages and model. It is not a nuclear-genome species tree or a definitive date for the origin of C. jacchus.
text.zh: 一项研究将 49 个新测序的柽柳猴属线粒体基因组与已发表序列合并，估计该研究采样的普通狨与黑耳狨卡廷加支系互为姐妹谱系，约在 51 万年前分化。这个估计受线粒体谱系采样和模型限制，不是核基因组物种树，也不是普通狨确定的起源日期。

title.en: Malukiewicz et al. (2024). Pelage variation and morphometrics of closely related Callithrix marmoset species and their hybrids.
title.zh: Malukiewicz 等（2024）：近缘柽柳猴属物种及其杂交个体的毛色变异与形态测量。

scope.en: Adult phenotyping and morphometric comparison from mixed wild and captive sources in Brazil during 2015–2019; not a complete life-stage morphology review.
scope.zh: 2015–2019 年巴西野生与圈养混合来源的成体表型和形态测量比较，不是完整的全生活史形态综述。

title.en: Benavides et al. (2022). Spatio-temporal dynamics of rabies and habitat suitability of the common marmoset in Brazil.
title.zh: Benavides 等（2022）：巴西普通狨狂犬病时空动态与栖地适宜性。

scope.en: Brazilian passive surveillance from 2008–2020 plus occurrence records and a habitat-suitability model; reported cases and predictions are distinct.
scope.zh: 巴西 2008–2020 年被动监测、出现记录及栖地适宜性模型；报告病例与模型预测分开解释。

title.en: Ziegler, Sosa & Colman (2017). Fathering style influences health outcome in common marmoset offspring.
title.zh: Ziegler、Sosa 与 Colman（2017）：父亲照料方式与普通狨幼体健康结果。

scope.en: One captive Wisconsin research colony; the analyzed design does not estimate wild behavior or survival.
scope.zh: 威斯康星一处圈养研究群体；该研究设计不估计野外行为或存活率。

title.en: Nogueira et al. (2022). Uniparental genetic markers to investigate hybridization in wild-born marmosets.
title.zh: Nogueira 等（2022）：用单亲遗传标记研究野生出生绒猴的杂交。

scope.en: Eighteen free-living putative hybrids from four southeastern Brazilian localities during 2004–2013; five carried the C. jacchus maternal haplotype.
scope.zh: 2004–2013 年巴西东南部四地的 18 只自由活动疑似杂交个体；其中 5 只带有普通狨母系单倍型。

title.en: Malukiewicz et al. (2021). Mitogenomic phylogeny of Callithrix with special focus on human transferred taxa.
title.zh: Malukiewicz 等（2021）：重点讨论人为转移类群的柽柳猴属线粒体基因组系统发育。

scope.en: Mitochondrial lineage and divergence-time analysis of sampled Callithrix; not a nuclear-genome species tree.
scope.zh: 对采样的柽柳猴属线粒体谱系与分化时间进行分析，不是核基因组物种树。

readerLimitations.en: This bilingual reader draft summarizes selected source-backed topics rather than a complete species review. The current evidence does not provide a wild diet, habitat-use, locomotion, body-size or lifespan synthesis, nor a current conservation assessment or population trend. The scientific dossier remains incomplete and has not received external expert review.
readerLimitations.zh: 这篇双语读者初稿概述的是有来源支持的若干主题，不是完整物种综述。当前材料不足以综合野外饮食、栖地利用、运动方式、体型或寿命，也没有当前保育评估或种群趋势。科学档案仍未完成，且尚未经过外部专家评审。

geography: Archaeological sample sites south of the Limpopo River across central and southern South Africa; sampled individuals date to 10,200–150 calibrated years before present. These localities do not delimit the current species range.
overview: COL26.8 accepted species usage 6MB3T identifies Homo sapiens (Linnaeus, 1758). The selected evidence concerns 28 ancient southern African individuals and their study-defined genomic comparisons; this is not a complete species review.

ecology.diet: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, collagen isotopes from 10 human remains, interpreted with 52 animal remains, indicated a large-terrestrial-mammal diet in a cold steppe–tundra setting. This single cave sample does not describe Homo sapiens generally.
ecology.habitat: The selected genomic study does not establish a species-wide habitat profile.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected core evidence.

evidenceSummary: A whole-genome study of 28 ancient southern African individuals dated 10,200–150 calibrated years before present found that samples older than 1,400 years fell outside the genetic-variation range of the study’s modern human comparison panel and carried many variants classified by the authors as Homo sapiens-specific. This is a sample-bounded population-genomic result, not a species-wide evolutionary history.
